description:
Carrier analysis currently requests Value executables broadly, and backend packaging then creates BackendCallableEntry records for every resolution. This pollutes first-class callable inventory for direct-only reducers that have no publication boundary.

Goal
Package a callable entry only when a transport publication boundary actually names its first-class value. Direct edges remain executable/direct-call authority.

Signal
compiler2_backend_program_keeps_direct_only_enum_reduce_out_of_callable_inventory fails on 00010_enum_reduce_main.fz because entries are emitted with empty boundary_ids.

Strategy
Keep the carrier analysis reachability it needs, but gate BackendCallableEntry packaging on boundary authority rather than facts.resolutions. Do not revise the test to accept phantom first-class inventory.

Acceptance
The direct-only inventory regression passes, and carrier/value tests retain their necessary published entries.
title: Keep direct-only callables out of first-class backend inventory
